title: Silent Visual Reading EEG
description: This dataset contains raw EEG recordings, in BrainVision format and organized according to BIDS, from participants silently reading word-by-word naturalistic narratives. It accompanies a study of auditory representations of words evoked during silent visual reading. Derivatives include preprocessed word-level EEG epochs, story and run metadata, expected/unexpected epoch labels, and corresponding feature embeddings.
methods_description: Participants viewed words forming naturalistic stories, presented one at a time on a grey background with a central fixation cross, while EEG was recorded with BrainVision. Triggers mark word onsets in unique versus repeated stories, as well as run onset and run end. Preprocessed data are provided as per-channel arrays of words by time points.
